verdict.rationale: Keycloak's admin docs explicitly document WebAuthn and a dedicated Passkeys section (conditional UI/autofill, modal UI, passkey mediation, loginless WebAuthn), showing first-class passwordless/passkey support. However, there is no evidence of built-in magic-link or email OTP sign-in as first-class methods—these are not mentioned anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: documentation of magic-link authentication, native email OTP flow, and independent/hands-on confirmation of passkey UX.
